parole: RX torace|RX del torace|radiografia del torace|chest X-ray|chest radiograph|CXR
segni: Check the technique first: PA or AP, inspiration (at least 9-10 posterior ribs above the diaphragm), rotation (spinous processes midway between the clavicles), penetration.
Then in order: devices, trachea and mediastinum, hila, lungs zone by zone comparing the two sides, pleura and costophrenic angles, heart, diaphragm, bones and soft tissues.
The “hidden zones”: apices, behind the heart, below the domes of the diaphragm, hila and mediastinum: always look at them.
classificazioni: Cardiothoracic ratio on PA: abnormal if greater than 0.5 (on AP the heart looks larger).
insidie: On a bedside AP film the heart looks enlarged and the mediastinum widened.
A supine effusion does not form a meniscus: it causes a diffuse haziness of the hemithorax.
Breast tissue and nipples can mimic nodules: compare with the lateral view.

parole: metasta|palla di cannone|noduli (polmonari )?multipli|masse polmonari multiple|metasta|cannonball|multiple (lung |pulmonary )?nodules|multiple (lung|pulmonary) masses
segni: Round nodules with sharp margins, of different sizes, predominating at the bases and in the periphery (hematogenous spread).
Lymphangitic carcinomatosis: interstitial thickening with septal lines and hilar lymph nodes.
classificazioni: Response to therapy is assessed with RECIST 1.1 (at most 2 target lesions per organ, 5 in total).
insidie: Multiple cavitating nodules: also consider septic emboli and granulomatosis with polyangiitis.
Typical primaries of cannonball metastases: kidney, colorectal, sarcomas, melanoma, testis, thyroid.

segni: The mean of the axes (long and short) and the type are measured: solid, ground-glass, part-solid.
Features favoring benignity: central, “popcorn” or laminated calcification, fat (hamartoma), stability of a solid nodule for 2 years.
A subpleural or perifissural nodule, triangular or lentiform, is usually an intrapulmonary lymph node.
classificazioni: Fleischner 2017: incidental solid nodule under 6 mm without follow-up in a low-risk patient; 6-8 mm follow-up at 6-12 months; over 8 mm consider CT at 3 months, PET or biopsy.
Lung-RADS applies only to low-dose screening CT.
insidie: Fleischner does not apply under age 35, in oncology patients and in immunocompromised patients.
A vessel cut in cross-section looks like a nodule: follow it on adjacent images or with MIP.

segni: Wall thickness: under 4 mm favors benignity, over 15 mm is suspicious for neoplasm (especially squamous).
Air-fluid level: common in abscess.
Location: apical and posterior segments of the upper lobes and apical segments of the lower lobes in tuberculosis.
insidie: If tuberculosis is suspected: respiratory isolation until excluded.
Bullae and cystic bronchiectasis have thin, smooth walls, without a solid component.

segni: Thin visceral pleural line, with no lung markings beyond it.
When supine, air moves anteriorly and inferiorly: deep, hyperlucent costophrenic sulcus (“deep sulcus sign”).
Signs of tension: contralateral mediastinal shift, flattening of the diaphragm.
classificazioni: Size (BTS): large if the distance between the chest wall and the lung at the level of the hilum is at least 2 cm.
insidie: A skin fold mimics the pleural line: it usually continues beyond the chest and has a blurred edge, not a thin line.
After central venous access or a pacemaker, always look for it.

parole: versamento pleurico|versamento bilaterale|velatura basale|seni costo-frenici|pleural effusion|bilateral effusion|basal haziness|costophrenic angles
segni: Upright: blunting of the costophrenic angle and meniscus (about 200 mL are needed on PA, 50 mL on lateral).
Supine: diffuse, gradual haziness of the hemithorax, without air bronchogram.
On CT: fluid density; pleural thickening and enhancement point to empyema or neoplasm.
insidie: Atelectasis and effusion often coexist: on CT the collapsed lung enhances, the fluid does not.
A massive effusion without mediastinal shift suggests an associated bronchial obstruction.

parole: sondino|catetere venoso|CVC|tubo endotracheale|drenagg|pacemaker|defibrillat|elettrocatetere|dispositivo impiantabile|nasogastric tube|feeding tube|central venous catheter|endotracheal tube|chest tube|drain|pacemaker|defibrillator|pacing lead|implantable device
segni: Endotracheal tube: tip 3-5 cm above the carina, with the head in neutral position.
Central venous catheter: tip at the junction of the superior vena cava and right atrium.
Nasogastric tube: runs down the midline, crosses the diaphragm, and the tip is in the stomach, at least 10 cm beyond the junction.
Pacemaker: follow each lead from the generator to the tip (atrium, right ventricle, coronary sinus) in two views.
insidie: Tube in the bronchus: it must be removed before use, risk of pneumonia and pneumothorax.
After every placement: look for pneumothorax, effusion and hematoma.
An angulation or a break in the lead between the clavicle and the first rib suggests a fracture.

segni: Endoluminal filling defect in the pulmonary arteries (acute: central, with meniscus-shaped margins).
Right heart strain: RV/LV ratio above 1, septal flattening, reflux of contrast into the inferior vena cava and hepatic veins.
insidie: Flow and breathing artifacts mimic thrombi: check the later phase and with wide windows.
Insufficient opacification (below about 250 HU in the pulmonary trunk) makes the exam non-diagnostic for peripheral branches.

segni: In the first hours: loss of gray-white matter differentiation, sulcal effacement, hyperdense artery sign.
Non-contrast CT is first of all used to exclude hemorrhage.
classificazioni: ASPECTS: 10 points in the middle cerebral artery territory, one subtracted for each affected region; below 6, thrombolysis carries more risk.
insidie: A normal CT in the first hours does not exclude ischemia.
Narrow window (W 30-40, L 35) to see early hypodensities.

segni: Epidural: biconvex, does not cross sutures. Subdural: crescent-shaped, crosses sutures but not the falx.
Subarachnoid: blood in the cisterns and sulci.
Mass effect: midline shift, ventricular compression, herniation.
insidie: Subacute subdural can be isodense to the cortex: look for sulcal effacement.
Always check the bone window (fractures) and an intermediate window for small collections.

segni: Periventricular and deep white matter hyperintensities on FLAIR/T2; ill-defined hypodensities on CT.
Lacunes: small CSF-filled cavities in the basal ganglia and internal capsule.
classificazioni: Fazekas (MRI): periventricular 0-3 and deep 0-3; deep 2-3 indicates significant small vessel disease.
insidie: Do not confuse with demyelinating lesions: ovoid shape perpendicular to the ventricles, juxtacortical, infratentorial and spinal cord locations (McDonald).
Dilated perivascular spaces follow CSF on all sequences.

segni: Loss of height anteriorly (wedge), centrally (biconcave) or of the whole body (collapse).
On MRI, edema on STIR indicates a recent collapse.
Favoring a neoplastic cause: vertebral body entirely replaced on T1, pedicle and posterior arch involved, convex posterior wall, soft-tissue mass.
classificazioni: Genant: grade 1 reduction 20-25%, grade 2 25-40%, grade 3 over 40%.
In trauma, stability is assessed with TLICS or AO Spine.
insidie: A fragility vertebral fracture indicates severe osteoporosis: it should be reported even if it is an incidental finding.
Count the levels starting from C2 or the sacrum, using the localizer that covers the longest segment.

parole: spondil|discopat|protrusion|ernia|stenosi del canale|laminectom|artros|spondyl|disc disease|disc protrusion|herniation|spinal stenosis|laminectom|arthrosis
segni: Disc: dehydration, loss of height, protrusion (broad base) or herniation (narrow base, extruded or migrated).
Canal stenosis: narrowed thecal sac, hypertrophy of the facet joints and ligamenta flava.
Operated spine: level of the laminectomy; degeneration accelerates above and below.
classificazioni: Modic: type 1 edema (T1 low, T2 high), type 2 fat (T1 and T2 high), type 3 sclerosis (T1 and T2 low).
insidie: Scar or recurrent herniation: gadolinium is needed; scar enhances, the disc fragment does not.
Foci that are hyperintense on both T1 and T2 in the vertebral bodies are hemangiomas or fat, not metastases.

segni: Low-dose CT without contrast: the ureters are followed from the renal pelvis to the bladder.
Stone with “rim sign” (ureteral wall around it); upstream dilatation and perirenal fat stranding.
classificazioni: A stone up to 5 mm in the distal ureter passes on its own in most cases; over 10 mm rarely.
insidie: Pelvic phleboliths often have the vein “tail” (comet tail) and a less dense center.
With fever and obstruction, urgent drainage is needed (nephrostomy or stent).

parole: Bosniak|cisti renal|massa renale|neoformazione renale|carcinoma renale|RENAL|PADUA|Bosniak|renal cyst|renal mass|kidney mass|renal neoplasm|renal carcinoma|renal cell carcinoma|RENAL|PADUA
segni: Enhancement: an increase of at least 20 HU between the unenhanced and the nephrographic phase indicates solid tissue.
Cysts: wall, septa, calcifications, nodules; each determines the category.
classificazioni: Bosniak 2019: I and II benign; IIF follow-up at 6 and 12 months, then annually for 5 years; III about 50% malignant; IV about 90%.
RENAL and PADUA: surgical complexity of solid masses (partial nephrectomy).
insidie: Without contrast, a homogeneous lesion between -9 and 20 HU is a benign cyst (Bosniak II).
Pseudo-enhancement of small, intraparenchymal cysts can exceed 10 HU.

segni: Common bile duct: dilated above about 7 mm (more in the elderly and after cholecystectomy).
Distended gallbladder with bile ducts dilated down to the pancreas (Courvoisier sign): distal obstruction, consider neoplasm of the pancreatic head or ampulla.
insidie: Common bile duct stones can be isodense to bile on CT: MRCP and endoscopic ultrasound are more sensitive.
Hypodense periportal bands can be edema or bile ducts: follow them to the hilum in the contrast phases.

parole: lesion[ei] (focal[ei] )?epatic|nodulo epatico|angioma|metastasi epatiche|LI-RADS|segment[oi] (epatic|[IVX]+\b)|S[1-8]\b|focal liver lesion|liver lesion|hepatic lesion|liver nodule|hepatic nodule|hemangioma|liver metastases|hepatic metastases|LI-RADS|(liver |hepatic )?segment (S?[1-8]|[IVX]+\b)
segni: Cyst: water, no enhancement. Hemangioma: peripheral nodular enhancement that fills in toward the center.
Hepatocellular carcinoma: arterial hyperenhancement and portal/delayed washout, capsule.
Hypovascular metastases: best seen in the portal venous phase.
classificazioni: LI-RADS only in at-risk patients (cirrhosis, hepatitis B, previous hepatocellular carcinoma).
Location using the Couinaud segments (I-VIII).
insidie: Lesions under 1 cm are often not characterizable: comparison and follow-up.
A hypovascular lesion cannot be excluded without contrast.

segni: Adenocarcinoma: hypodense mass in the pancreatic phase, dilatation of the Wirsung duct and common bile duct (“double duct sign”), upstream atrophy.
Resectability: contact with the superior mesenteric artery, celiac trunk, superior mesenteric vein and portal vein (in degrees).
classificazioni: Resectability according to NCCN: resectable, borderline, locally advanced.
insidie: A small mass can be isodense: the double duct sign is often the most evident sign.
Pancreatic cysts must always be characterized (IPMN, cystadenomas).

segni: Correct MLO: pectoral muscle down to the level of the nipple, inframammary fold visible. CC: nipple in profile, nipple-to-pectoral distance within 1 cm of that on the MLO.
Compare the two breasts and the prior exams: a new or growing density is suspicious.
classificazioni: BI-RADS: 0 needs further work-up, 1 negative, 2 benign, 3 probably benign (short-interval follow-up), 4 suspicious (biopsy), 5 highly suspicious, 6 known malignancy.
ACR density: A fatty, B scattered fibroglandular, C heterogeneously dense, D extremely dense.
insidie: A lesion seen in only one view can be a superimposition: spot compression or tomosynthesis.
Fine, pleomorphic or linear/segmental calcifications are suspicious even without a mass.

parole: ecografia (della )?mamm|nodulo mammario|ecografia mammaria|breast ultrasound|breast US|breast nodule|breast mass
segni: Suspicious: irregular shape, angular or spiculated margins, non-parallel orientation (taller than wide), posterior shadowing.
Favoring benignity: oval shape, circumscribed margins, parallel orientation, posterior enhancement.
classificazioni: Ultrasound BI-RADS with side, clock position (as if facing the patient) and distance from the nipple.
insidie: The axilla should always be examined in suspicious lesions.
A complicated cyst has internal echoes but no vascularity on color Doppler.

segni: Check: position of the components, alignment, intact fixation hardware, fracture healing.
Loosening: radiolucency around the implant over 2 mm or increasing over time, migration of the components.
classificazioni: Periprosthetic hip fractures: Vancouver classification.
insidie: Two views are needed: a single one does not show the depth of screws and nails.
Always compare with the previous follow-up: change matters more than a single appearance.

segni: Fracture line, cortical interruption, step-off, displacement and angulation of the fragments.
Indirect signs: joint effusion (elevated fat pad), fat-fluid levels (lipohemarthrosis).
classificazioni: Describe location, type (nondisplaced/displaced, comminuted), joint involvement and displacement.
insidie: Always at least two orthogonal views.
Some fractures (scaphoid, femoral neck) may not be visible at first: MRI or CT if clinical suspicion persists.

segni: Water at 0 HU (typical tolerance ±4-5 HU), air at -1000 HU.
Noise = standard deviation in the ROI: it increases with thin slices, sharp kernels and lower dose (roughly as 1/√mAs).
Spatial resolution: improves with sharp kernels and small fields of view.
insidie: Motion artifacts: double contours and streaks; beam hardening: dark bands between dense structures; ring artifacts: detector problem.
An object outside the scan field causes truncation artifacts and falsified densities at the periphery.

segni: Physiologic uptake: brain, myocardium, urinary tract, sometimes bowel and brown fat.
SUV: depends on weight, dose and time; compare with the liver and the blood pool.
classificazioni: Lymphomas: Deauville scale (1-5) relative to the mediastinum and liver.
insidie: Metformin greatly increases colonic uptake.
Low uptake does not exclude neoplasm (slow-growing adenocarcinomas, lesions under 1 cm).

parole: scompenso|edema polmonare|cardiomegalia|ombra cardiaca|Kerley|ridistribuzione|heart failure|pulmonary edema|cardiomegaly|cardiac silhouette|Kerley|redistribution
segni: Enlarged cardiac silhouette (cardiothoracic ratio above 0.5 on PA).
Redistribution of the circulation toward the apices (upper lobe vessels equal to or larger than the basal ones).
Interstitial edema: Kerley B lines at the bases, thickening of the fissures and peribronchial cuffing, blurred hila.
Alveolar edema: bilateral perihilar opacities in a “butterfly” pattern, often with bilateral pleural effusion, more often on the right.
classificazioni: Classic sequence as pulmonary capillary pressure rises: redistribution → interstitial edema → alveolar edema (the mmHg thresholds are indicative and the signs appear later than the clinical picture).
insidie: On bedside AP and in the supine position, the heart and apical vessels look larger: redistribution cannot be assessed.
A pericardial effusion gives a “flask-shaped” cardiac silhouette that mimics cardiomegaly.
In emphysema and with the patient lying on one side, edema can be asymmetric.

segni: Left ventricular systolic function: ejection fraction (Simpson biplane preferable to visual estimate) and segmental wall motion.
Right ventricle: size relative to the left and TAPSE.
Pericardial effusion: thickness in diastole and signs of tamponade (diastolic collapse of the right atrium and ventricle, dilated inferior vena cava that does not collapse).
classificazioni: Heart failure by ejection fraction (ESC guidelines): reduced ≤ 40%, mildly reduced 41-49%, preserved ≥ 50%.
TAPSE below 17 mm: reduced right ventricular systolic function.
Pericardial effusion: mild under 10 mm, moderate 10-20 mm, large over 20 mm.
insidie: Oblique views foreshorten the ventricle and falsify volumes and ejection fraction.
Anterior epicardial fat can mimic a small effusion.
Tamponade is a clinical-hemodynamic diagnosis: what matters is chamber compression, not just the amount of fluid.

titolo: Cardiac MRI: late enhancement and myocarditis
segni: Subendocardial or transmural late enhancement in a coronary territory: sequela of infarction (ischemic origin).
Midwall or subepicardial enhancement, not in a coronary territory: non-ischemic origin (myocarditis, dilated cardiomyopathy, sarcoidosis).
Myocarditis: T2 edema or increased T1/T2 maps, subepicardial enhancement often of the inferolateral wall.
Amyloidosis: diffuse subendocardial enhancement and difficulty in “nulling” the myocardium.
classificazioni: 2018 Lake Louise criteria for myocarditis: at least one T2-based criterion (edema) and at least one T1-based criterion (T1 map, extracellular volume or late enhancement).
insidie: A wrong inversion time makes the enhancement look diffuse or hides it.
Breathing and arrhythmia artifacts mimic wall defects.
The transmural extent of enhancement predicts recovery after revascularization: above 50%, recovery is unlikely.

segni: Dissection: intimal flap separating true and false lumen; the false lumen is usually larger, with an acute angle to the wall (“beak”) and sometimes filaments (“cobwebs”).
Intramural hematoma: crescent-shaped wall thickening, hyperdense on the non-contrast phase, without a flap or flow.
Penetrating ulcer: outpouching of contrast beyond the calcified wall, usually in an atheromatous descending aorta.
Signs of severity: pericardial effusion or hemothorax, malperfusion of viscera and limbs, rupture.
classificazioni: Stanford A: involves the ascending aorta (usually surgical); Stanford B: does not involve it.
DeBakey I (ascending and beyond), II (ascending only), III (descending only).
insidie: Pulsation artifact of the aortic root mimics a flap: ECG-gated acquisition is needed.
Without the unenhanced phase, an intramural hematoma goes unnoticed.
A thrombosed false lumen is confused with mural thrombus of an aneurysm: look at the shape and the displacement of intimal calcifications.

segni: It is measured on non-contrast ECG-gated CT (3 mm slices, 120 kV); on non-gated chest CT a visual estimate can be given.
Coronary calcifications should always be reported, even on CT performed for other reasons.
classificazioni: Classic Agatston categories: 0 no calcium; 1-99 mild; 100-399 moderate; ≥ 400 severe. CAC-DRS uses slightly different thresholds: 0, 1-99, 100-299, ≥ 300.
Visual estimate on non-gated CT: absent, mild, moderate, severe.
insidie: Calcifications of valves, mitral annulus and pericardium should not be counted.
With contrast, calcium is overestimated or confused with the opacified lumen.
A score of 0 does not exclude non-calcified plaques, especially in young patients with symptoms.

segni: Main indications: staging of high-risk prostate cancer and biochemical recurrence (even with low PSA).
Physiologic uptake: salivary and lacrimal glands, kidneys and urinary tract, bowel, liver and spleen.
Look for prostatic lesions, pelvic and extrapelvic lymph nodes, bones and viscera.
classificazioni: Reporting systems: PROMISE (miTNM) and PSMA-RADS (from 1, benign, to 5, almost certain carcinoma).
insidie: Ganglia (celiac, stellate, sacral) and fractures or Paget disease can show uptake: look at the shape and location on CT.
A proportion of tumors, especially with neuroendocrine differentiation, do not express PSMA.
Other tumors (kidney, liver) also show uptake because of neoangiogenesis: PSMA is not specific to the prostate.

segni: Indicated in well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumors: staging, search for the primary and choice of peptide receptor radionuclide therapy.
Physiologic uptake: spleen (the most intense), adrenals, kidneys, pituitary, liver, thyroid and uncinate process of the pancreas.
classificazioni: Krenning score: lesion uptake relative to liver and spleen; for peptide receptor radionuclide therapy, uptake at least equal to the liver is required.
In G3 or poorly differentiated tumors uptake decreases: FDG PET is complementary.
insidie: The uncinate process of the pancreas often shows uptake: do not mistake it for a tumor.
Accessory spleens and splenosis show intense uptake.
Inflammation and some non-neuroendocrine tumors can express the receptors.

titolo: PET in neurology: FDG, amyloid and DOPA
segni: FDG in Alzheimer disease: temporoparietal and posterior cingulate hypometabolism.
Frontotemporal dementia: frontal and anterior temporal hypometabolism.
Dementia with Lewy bodies: occipital hypometabolism with relatively preserved posterior cingulate (“cingulate island sign”).
Amyloid PET: positive when the contrast between cortical gray and white matter is lost.
DOPA PET or dopamine transporter scintigraphy: reduced striatal uptake in degenerative parkinsonism.
classificazioni: Amyloid PET is read visually (positive/negative) according to the radiopharmaceutical's rules; the quantitative value (SUVR, Centiloid) is supportive.
insidie: Atrophy reduces uptake through partial volume effect: compare with MRI.
Positive amyloid is common in elderly people without dementia: on its own it is not a diagnosis of Alzheimer disease.
Drugs (neuroleptics, some antidepressants) alter the uptake of dopaminergic tracers.

parole: età ossea|eta ossea|Greulich|accrescimento|bassa statura|puber|bone age|Greulich|growth|short stature|pubert
segni: X-ray of the left hand and wrist in dorsopalmar projection.
Ossification centers, epiphyseal shape and closure of the growth plates are compared with the atlas.
classificazioni: Greulich and Pyle atlas (the most used) or Tanner-Whitehouse method (score per bone).
Significant delay or advance: more than about 2 standard deviations from chronological age.
insidie: The standards differ for males and females and derive from populations of decades ago: in some ethnic groups the estimate shifts.
Differences between the right and left hand are small but the method is calibrated on the left.
In late adolescence, the distal radius and ulna matter most.

segni: Ultrasound: “target” or “doughnut” mass in transverse section, “pseudokidney” in longitudinal, usually in the right quadrant.
Typical ileocolic form, between 6 months and 3 years.
Assess wall flow, trapped fluid and lymph nodes.
classificazioni: Small, short small-bowel intussusceptions (diameter under about 2.5 cm, without obstruction) are often transient.
insidie: Image-guided hydrostatic or pneumatic reduction: contraindicated with peritonitis, perforation or shock.
After age 3, or if recurrent, look for a cause (Meckel diverticulum, polyp, lymphoma).
Stool and thickened loops can mimic the doughnut: look for the layered structure.

segni: Infant of 2-8 weeks with non-bilious projectile vomiting.
Ultrasound: thickened pyloric muscle and elongated canal that does not open during observation.
classificazioni: Reference values: muscle thickness ≥ 3 mm and canal length ≥ 15-17 mm.
insidie: Pylorospasm gives borderline measurements: observe for a few minutes to see whether the contents pass.
A very distended stomach displaces the pylorus backward: change the child's position.
Bilious vomiting is not due to pyloric stenosis: consider malrotation with volvulus (emergency).

segni: Fractures typical of immature bone: greenstick, “torus” (buckled cortex), plastic deformation.
Fractures involving the growth plate: they can disturb growth.
If abuse is suspected: angular metaphyseal or “bucket-handle” fractures, posterior rib fractures, multiple fractures of different ages, fractures inconsistent with the history.
classificazioni: Salter-Harris: I through the physis; II physis and metaphysis (the most frequent); III physis and epiphysis; IV through metaphysis, physis and epiphysis; V crushing of the physis.
insidie: A Salter-Harris I may not be visible: widening of the physis and soft-tissue swelling; compare with the healthy side.
Accessory or not yet fused ossification centers mimic fractures.
If abuse is suspected, a complete skeletal survey according to protocol and the required reporting are needed.

parole: displasia|anca del neonato|Graf|lussazione congenita|dysplasia|infant hip|newborn hip|Graf|congenital dislocation
segni: Ultrasound in the first months, in the standard coronal section with the ilium straight.
The alpha angle (bony roof) and beta angle (cartilaginous roof) and femoral head coverage are measured.
classificazioni: Graf: type I, alpha ≥ 60° (mature hip); IIa, 50-59° under 3 months (immature, to be rechecked); IIb, 50-59° after 3 months; IIc and D, 43-49°; III and IV, under 43° (decentered or dislocated hip).
insidie: A section outside the standard plane falsifies the angles: the ilium must be straight and parallel to the probe.
In the first weeks, physiologic laxity gives borderline findings.
After 4-6 months the ossification center hides the structures: switch to pelvic X-ray.

parole: appendic|fossa iliaca destra|appendic|right iliac fossa|right lower quadrant
segni: Non-compressible appendix with a diameter over 6 mm, thickened wall, appendicolith.
Hyperechoic periappendiceal fat (ultrasound) or stranding (CT), free fluid.
Complications: perforation (wall defect, extraluminal air), abscess, peritonitis.
classificazioni: In children and in pregnancy, start with ultrasound; CT (or MRI in pregnancy) if ultrasound is inconclusive.
insidie: A retrocecal or pelvic appendix is difficult to see on ultrasound: not seeing it does not exclude appendicitis.
A diameter of 6-7 mm without other signs is a borderline value.
Mesenteric lymphadenitis, ileitis and ovarian disease give the same clinical picture.

segni: Tear: high signal in the meniscus reaching the articular surface on at least two images (short-TE sequences).
Bucket-handle tear: fragment in the intercondylar notch (“double posterior cruciate sign”), meniscus smaller than normal.
Root tear: “ghost” meniscus and extrusion over 3 mm.
classificazioni: Signal grades: 1 and 2 within the meniscus (degeneration), 3 reaches the surface (tear).
Types: longitudinal, radial, horizontal, complex, flap, bucket-handle.
insidie: The transverse ligament and the meniscofemoral ligaments mimic tears of the anterior or posterior horn.
Magic angle effect on short-TE sequences.
The signal remains abnormal after a repair: for operated menisci, comparison or MR arthrography is needed.

segni: Direct signs: fiber discontinuity, horizontalized course (flatter than Blumensaat's line), high signal.
Indirect signs: contusions of the lateral femoral condyle and posterolateral tibial plateau, anterior tibial translation, buckled posterior cruciate ligament.
Segond fracture (avulsion of the lateral tibial margin): almost always associated.
classificazioni: Complete or partial tear; acute or chronic (ligament absent or adherent to the posterior cruciate).
insidie: Mucoid degeneration thickens the ligament (“celery stalk”) but the fibers are continuous.
Partial tears are difficult: look at all the sections and the oblique planes.
Always assess the menisci and collateral ligaments: associated injuries change the surgery.

segni: Tendinosis: thickened tendon with intermediate signal, without fluid signal.
Partial tear: fluid signal on the articular side, bursal side or within the tendon, without crossing the full thickness.
Full-thickness tear: fluid signal from one surface to the other; measure width and retraction.
Muscle atrophy and fatty infiltration on sagittal sections.
classificazioni: Goutallier (fatty infiltration, 0-4): from 3 upward, repair gives worse results.
Tendon retraction according to Patte (1-3).
insidie: Magic angle effect in the supraspinatus on short-TE sequences: compare with T2-weighted images.
Partial volume with the infraspinatus mimics a lesion.
Fluid in the subacromial bursa does not necessarily mean a tear.

parole: edema osseo|edema del midollo|contusione ossea|osteonecros|frattura da stress|frattura da insufficienza|STIR|bone edema|marrow edema|bone contusion|osteonecros|stress fracture|insufficiency fracture|STIR
segni: Hyperintense edema on STIR or fat-suppressed T2: contusion, fracture, overload, infection, tumor.
Hypointense line on T1 within the edema: fracture (stress or insufficiency).
Osteonecrosis: area bounded by a rim, with the double line sign on T2.
classificazioni: T1 rule: normal marrow is brighter than muscle and disc; a T1 signal lower than muscle suggests infiltration or fracture.
Osteonecrosis of the femoral head: ARCO 2019 stages I to IV, with collapse of the surface from stage III.
insidie: Residual red marrow (especially in young people and women) gives heterogeneous signal but on T1 it remains higher than muscle.
Transient hip edema heals on its own: no rim or line.
Edema without an evident cause in a typical stress site (metatarsals, femoral neck, sacrum) should be searched for on thin sections.

segni: The most frequently torn ligament is the anterior talofibular, then the calcaneofibular.
Syndesmotic injury (anterior tibiofibular): “high” ankle sprain, slower healing.
Assess talar contusions and osteochondral lesions, peroneal tendons and Achilles tendon.
classificazioni: Ligament injuries: strain (continuous fibers with edema), partial tear, complete tear.
insidie: The anterior talofibular ligament is well seen only on correctly oriented axial sections.
A peroneus brevis tendon split in two simulates two normal tendons.
An osteochondral lesion of the talus can cause persistent pain: look at the dome in all planes.
